'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Brian Brodsky DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Brodsky]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' B. Brodsky
* '''Deck name:''' ISB Ops
* '''Username:''' bbrodsky50
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
